dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, scalloped 'O' and 'C' shaped ring structures with sharp contrast gradients between dark charcoal backgrounds and light-grey internal regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid, high-intensity light-grey pixel clusters scattered in the inter-annular spaces, particularly concentrated on the mid-lateral flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of three prominent dorsal macro-annuli form a scalene triangle; secondary geometric patterns consist of a series of irregular quadrilaterals formed by smaller lateral blobs.
